news.title: US leaders urge action as delays threaten fall enrolments
news.summary_en: Higher education leaders in the US are urging policymakers to demand visa processing improvements, as delays threaten to wreak havoc on this fall’s international enrolments.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: US set to expand exchange visitor termination rules
news.summary_en: US proposals to expand exchange visitor termination rules appear to be a routine regulatory update, though some stakeholders remain wary of the rule's wording.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Chinese group to buy Kaplan’s Dublin Business School in $125.5m deal
news.summary_en: China Chunlai Education Group Co is set to acquire Dublin Business School (DBS) from Kaplan in a deal worth a reported USD$127.5 million.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: QQI unveils first TrustEd Ireland Quality Mark recipients
news.summary_en: Quality and Qualifications Ireland (QQI) has announced the first English Language Education (ELE) providers authorised to use the TrustEd Ireland Quality Mark, a new statutory accreditation program designed to strengthen quality assurance and support the protection of international students.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Universities and test providers debate access to English language test responses
news.summary_en: A growing trend among some English language testing providers to give university admissions teams access to candidates' spoken responses has sparked debate over whether greater transparency improves admissions decisions.
news.author: Amy Baker

news.title: US universities sell opportunity. A $100k OPT fee could change the product
news.summary_en: News that the Trump administration is eyeing a $100,000 fee for OPT poses a serious risk to US international education, warns Richard T. Herman.
news.author: Richard T. Herman

news.title: Benchmarking report maps evolving US international recruitment
news.summary_en: A new benchmarking report gives US institutions insights into evolving international recruitment practices as policy turbulence and visa challenges dramatically shift the operating environment.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Australia: Pearson launches International Student Advisory Board
news.summary_en: Pearson has launched an International Student Advisory Board, bringing together student leaders from across Australia to shape conversations on education and employability.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Sweeping work permit refusals draw student protests in Canada
news.summary_en: Stakeholders say providing immigration advice to prospective international students should be a mandatory requirement in Canada, following student protests and a hunger strike over a spate of PGWP refusals.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Australian universities urged to rethink engagement with Pakistan
news.summary_en: Speakers at The PIE Live Asia Pacific argued Pakistan is being viewed too narrowly through the lens of visa risk, warning that uncertainty is undermining Australia's competitiveness in one of its fastest-growing student markets.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: UK uni faculty uneasy over international student ‘cash cow’ label
news.summary_en: Staff at UK universities are uncomfortable with the 'cash cow' label that has been applied to international students in recent years – despite finding the term and accurate descriptor in the current political climate, a report has found.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Students challenge UK ‘visa brake’ in High Court
news.summary_en: Two landmark cases were brought against the UK Home Office last week, challenging the government’s controversial ‘visa brake’ halting study visa issuance to nationals of Afghanistan, Cameroon, Sudan and Myanmar.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Lessons from Queensland’s K‑12 international leaders
news.summary_en: From agent relationships to offshore delivery, school leaders at The PIE High shared what’s shaping international education in Queensland’s schools.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Leaders call for coordinated action as Australia’s social licence shows cracks
news.summary_en: Public confidence in Australia’s international education sector is under pressure, with leaders warning that social licence can no longer be treated as someone else's problem.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: University College Birmingham unveils £15m hospitality expansion
news.summary_en: The university has said the £15 million investment will create more than 150 jobs while giving students paid work, placements and hands-on experience in live commercial environments, as UK universities face growing pressure to deliver stronger career outcomes.
news.author: Abhishek Nair
